meta.name: plan
meta.description: Sequence an understood outcome into verifiable delivery slices with dependencies, ownership and acceptance checks. Use for delivery planning, estimation or migration strategy.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把目标拆成可验收的交付切片,理清依赖、责任人和验收标准。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手上有目标要落地,却不知道怎么拆成一步步可验收的交付。
copy.tagline_en: Break a goal into verifiable delivery slices with owners and acceptance checks.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a goal to ship but need to slice it into verifiable, owned steps.

howto.what: 把已经理解清楚的目标拆成可验证的交付切片，标注依赖、负责人和验收检查。产出用于交付规划、估算或迁移策略的排期结果，遇到缺失能力或未跑的检查会如实说明。
howto.when: 当你要求做交付规划、估算或迁移策略时接管；若由 @fde 调用，则复用其当前的已脱敏包与范围，不重启设置或重复提问。

say.text: 把这个目标拆成可验证的交付切片，标好依赖和负责人
say.note: 产出带验收检查的交付计划

say.text: 帮我估算这个迁移方案，分段列出依赖和验收标准
say.note: 按切片给出依赖与验收项

say.text: 按已确认的范围做交付规划，别重新问一遍
say.note: 复用已有上下文，不重复设置

howto.what_en: Claude turns an understood outcome into verifiable delivery slices with dependencies, ownership and acceptance checks. It produces delivery, estimation or migration plans, and honestly reports missing capabilities or unrun checks.
howto.when_en: Triggers on delivery planning, estimation or migration strategy. When called by @fde it reuses that sanitized packet and scope instead of restarting setup or discovery.

say_en.text: Turn this outcome into verifiable delivery slices with dependencies and owners
say_en.note: Produces a delivery plan with acceptance checks

say_en.text: Help me estimate this migration, split into slices with dependencies and acceptance
Plan delivery within the confirmed scope, don't re-ask setup questions
